phase: Phase 5 C4 — Device-C UNCONSTRAINED design comparison
question: On Device-C (kappa FREE / unconstrained), does the learned-m_s gradient beat (a) the reduce-kappa heuristic and (b) gradient-free CMA at raising TRUE 80-mode m_s?

framings.zeroshot: MAST-U shape->m_s surrogate (surrogate.pt) transfers UNCHANGED; composed with a Device-C ShapeMap (controls->shape, trained on Device-C probe/shapegen). Strongest evidence of 'learned physics, not MAST-U geometry'.
framings.retrained: Device-C-retrained shape->m_s surrogate (clean ablation; needs an 80-mode Device-C dataset).

protocol.design_space: top-d=12 PCA over Device-C control distribution; box = [p2,p98] PC-score range
protocol.step: MAX_STEP=0.45, line-search {step, step/2, step/4}; reset-on-stall so every method spends the FULL budget (equal true-solve count)
protocol.fairness: each method ranks candidates by its OWN objective (surrogate->predicted m_s; reduce_kappa->predicted kappa reduction; cma->true m_s); every step confirmed by ONE true 80-mode solve; a step is accepted only if TRUE m_s improves; no early break.

primary_metric: win-rate: fraction of starts where surrogate.best_ms > reduce_kappa.best_ms (paired, same start). Reported with Wilson 95% CI + two-sided paired Wilcoxon on (best_ms_surrogate - best_ms_reduce_kappa) + two-sided sign test.
resolution: ALWAYS resolved by the TRUE 80-mode START m_s regime (marginal <0.4 / mid 0.4-1.0 / stable). Never aggregate without the regime breakdown.
replication: a DISJOINT replication cohort of starts (separate from main) must reproduce the marginal result (pre-registered, not pooled-only).

DECISION.WIN: surrogate beats reduce_kappa UNCONSTRAINED, two-sided Wilcoxon p<0.05, AND replicated out-of-sample. => the learned m_s is a transferable physical model (thesis-closing).
DECISION.TIE: within noise (Wilcoxon n.s. or not replicated). => kappa-dominance is general to tokamak vertical stability; the delivered contribution remains the fixed-kappa differentiator + amortized solver-confirmed loop. Honest, still strong.
DECISION.note: The metric is the DESIGN-LOOP lever attribution, never raw prediction accuracy. A within-noise 'win' is NOT a win.
